questions.silhouette: Can the creature body be recognized from its outline alone?
questions.organ_clarity: Are sensors, expression cells, and body core easy to identify?
questions.palette_contrast: Does the palette separate body, organs, and background?
questions.animation_readiness: Is there a clear anchor or pose feature for simple motion?
questions.companion_appeal: Does the grid read as a plausible companion rather than noise?

instructions: Rate each sample independently before seeing generator source.
Use 1 for unreadable/noisy, 3 for usable but ambiguous, and 5 for immediately legible.
Do not treat novelty as readability unless the creature remains recognizable.
Record reviewer id, timestamp, and optional notes separately from proxy metrics.

limitations: Human ratings are protocol-defined but not collected in Stage 0.
Proxy readability weights are hand-set and must be calibrated against ratings.
The held-out set is deterministic and small; it is a benchmark seed, not a final study.
